rationale: The papers [2211.16790], [2001.02222], [2309.07751], [2312.01578], and [2409.16964] provide evidence on the host galaxy properties and environments of fast radio bursts, such as their occurrence in dwarf and spiral galaxies, dispersion measures, and spatial distributions within host galaxies. These findings contribute to understanding the influence of host properties on FRB characteristics, but do not fully settle the question.
